bagPolicy.note: The house rules apply to all events, including concerts.

parking.note: Parking can be reserved in advance to ensure a good spot near the stadium. The venue is easily accessible by both car and public transport.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Johan Cruijff ArenA's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Johan Cruijff ArenA offers a variety of food and drink options, including refreshing beverages and snacks available at kiosks. Notable dining experiences include Restaurant ON5TH by Lute®, Glasgow '72 Lounge, and House of Legends, which offers Indonesian cuisine.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Johan Cruijff ArenA, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Johan Cruijff ArenA's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Johan Cruijff ArenA. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The escalators are located at several entrances: main entrance E and entrances A, C, G, J and M.
